chats.title: Please tell me the allocation logic for ISG Service.

messages.text: Please tell me the allocation logic for ISG Service.

blocks.title: Allocation scope and eligible inputs
blocks.text: Allocate ISG Service costs by quarter, profit center and bpc_seg_cd, using the share of revenue after allocation (Rev%). The revenue base includes AMTREV, IMMDREV and GTN rows where checking_flg=AL and non_alloc_flg is not Y. Cost inputs are BMC and NBMC rows where checking_flg is blank and non_alloc_flg is not Y.

blocks.title: Copy costs before allocating the pool
blocks.text: Costs with an existing bpc_seg_cd are copied to that segment, regardless of alloc_flg. If bpc_seg_cd is blank, alloc_flg=B and refreshed_gtm_cust_seg_leve2 has a value, map SM to B0 and MM to SMBMM; retain other values and copy the cost. Other costs with a blank bpc_seg_cd enter the allocation pool. An A-class cost with missing bpc_seg_cd also triggers the A-class missing-dimension check.

blocks.title: Month 1 and month 2 allocation
blocks.text: For month 1 and month 2, Rev%[segment] = the month revenue base for that segment / the total month revenue base for the profit center. Allocated cost[segment] = the month allocation pool × that month Rev%. Keep copied costs separate from the allocated pool.

blocks.title: Month 3 quarterly true-up
blocks.text: For month 3, calculate quarterly Rev% from the quarter revenue base. Month 3 allocated cost[segment] = quarter allocation pool × quarterly Rev%[segment] − month 1 executed allocation[segment] − month 2 executed allocation[segment]. Deduct prior pool allocations only, not copied costs. In the approved close scenario, months 1–2 stay locked and only month 3 true-up is recalculated.

blocks.title: No-base default and unresolved boundaries
blocks.text: When there is no revenue base, allocate the cost pool to B0 (no_base_default_seg). Do not automatically treat a net-zero, near-zero or negative total revenue base as the no-row case; those boundary policies require separate confirmation. A negative true-up can be a valid quarterly adjustment and is not by itself proof of a posting error.

blocks.title: Service categories and amount selection
blocks.text: Revenue categories are AMTREV, IMMDREV and GTN; cost categories are BMC and NBMC. Select amt_lc for geo_cd=PRC; select amt for other geographies, including ROW. The sample displays USD. The field-selection rule alone does not establish the currency of every real dataset.
